topic: Ignoring the employee stock purchase plan vs enrolling and selling the discounted shares right away (Lars vs Imelda)

scenes.narration: Some workers skip a guaranteed fifteen percent raise every year. Today's patient checkup starts here.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in a bright clinic holding a clipboard with a stock certificate stamped FIFTEEN PERCENT OFF, comic burst banner reads FREE RAISE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Lars and Imelda both work at a company with a stock purchase plan.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split clinic panel of man lars and woman imelda at office desks, a benefits poster reads ESPP, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The plan sells company shares at a fifteen percent discount from paycheck money.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a benefits page reading BUY SHARES AT FIFTEEN PERCENT DISCOUNT, a paycheck arrow, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Lars skips it. Stocks feel risky and the form looks long.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man lars closing a benefits form with a shrug, a thought bubble reads TOO RISKY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He leaves about fifteen hundred dollars a year on the table.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a table with a pile of cash reading FIFTEEN HUNDRED, man lars walking away, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Ten years, fifteen thousand dollars of free money never collected.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a clipboard chart with ten empty bars, a tag reads FIFTEEN THOUSAND MISSED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Imelda enrolls at ten percent of her pay.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman imelda checking a box reading CONTRIBUTE TEN PERCENT on the enrollment form, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Every six months, the shares land and she sells them the same day.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman imelda tapping SELL on a phone the day shares arrive, a calendar reads EVERY SIX MONTHS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: No company stock risk, just the discount locked in as cash.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a cash pile labeled DISCOUNT PROFIT, a company stock icon crossed out, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She moves the profit into her index fund every time.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman imelda transferring cash into an account labeled INDEX FUND, a rising chart, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Ten years later that habit is worth over twenty thousand dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a clinic growth chart climbing to TWENTY THOUSAND, woman imelda flexing, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Enroll, sell the same day, invest the gain. See you next visit. Stay financially healthy!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in a bright clinic holding a clipboard reading ENROLL AND SELL SAME DAY, a healthy growth chart behind her, kids comic book illustration
